product_summary: Manufacturer of orthopaedic implants and orthopaedic surgical instruments since 1990 (incorporated 2000), Rajkot (Metoda GIDC, Plot G-2041-42/A). Product lines per own website: trauma fixation (small/large fragment locking and non-locking plates, screws), nailing systems (elastic nails, G-PFN, humeral, multilock humeral, PFN, PFN-2, expert tibia, XL interlocking tibia & femoral, DHS/DCS, femoral neck system), foot & ankle (cannulated screws, pin & wire, ankle fusion nail), spinal (pedicle, anterior/posterior cervical screw, laminoplasty, cervical cage), maxillofacial (1.5/2.0/2.4 mm locking and non-locking implants), arthroscopy, hip prosthesis, external fixators/LRS and Ilizarov, veterinary line, and a full general orthopaedic instrument range. Claims ISO 13485:2016 and CE. Source: https://hardikinternational.com (homepage, product navigation and 'About' text).

comment: HS 902110 is CORRECT and fully corroborated by the product range: bone plates, screws, nails, fixators, spinal and maxillofacial implants are orthopaedic/fracture appliances. HS 902300 is WRONG for this company: 9023 covers instruments/apparatus for demonstration purposes (teaching/display models) and is not supported by any product line on the website - no anatomical or demonstration models are offered. The declared pair therefore misses the company's second core business, orthopaedic surgical instruments, which belong in 9018 (901890), and does not separately reflect artificial joints (902131) if hip/knee prostheses are declared as such. Recommended correction: 902110 (primary) + 901890 (instruments) + 902131 (hip/knee/arthroscopy joint implants), dropping 902300. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a clear MISCLASSIFICATION - the company is a medical device / orthopaedic implant manufacturer (would sit under medical devices/pharma-adjacent, not oil & gas or chemicals); no oilfield, petrochemical or chemical product appears anywhere on the site. No customs line was available to me in this task, so all product-to-HS mapping above is derived from the company's own website and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; the product taxonomy itself is explicit and detailed, which makes the 902110 mapping high-confidence and the 902300 mapping unsupported. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground - company retained, code corrected to actual. Note: the site's 'client reviews' block (Rahul Mehta, Priya Sharma, Amit Verma, Sneha Kulkarni) reads as marketing/testimonial copy, not as evidence of supply; no GST turnover, contract or public-procurement record was examined here (out of scope for this role).
